summary.text: Shirley Arriaga is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 8th Hampden District since January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Air Force veteran who served from 2010 to 2020, she earned a master's degree in international law and legal studies from Western New England University.

paragraphs.text: Shirley Arriaga earned an associate degree in liberal arts and sciences from Springfield Technical Community College in 2009, a bachelor's degree in legal studies from the College of Our Lady of the Elms in 2015, an associate degree from the Community College of the Air Force in 2019, and a master's degree in international law and legal studies from Western New England University in 2020.

She served in the U.S. Air Force from 2010 to 2020, and her career experience includes working as a community outreach specialist with Veterans Inc. and as a congressional liaison in the office of Congressman Richard E. Neal.

Arriaga succeeded Joseph Wagner in the 8th Hampden District seat; for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the House Ways and Means Committee and the Higher Education, Public Health, Veterans and Federal Affairs, and Ways and Means joint committees.
